playlists.description:
This playlist explores what happens when each planet moves through the 12 zodiac signs in a natal chart.

The planet shows the type of energy.
The sign shows how that energy expresses itself.

When you understand your planets in signs, you begin to see your natural patterns in communication, relationships, motivation, emotions, and belief systems. You start recognizing why you respond the way you do, why certain strengths feel effortless, and why certain challenges repeat.

Each video in this series focuses on one planet in one sign in a clear and grounded way. This is astrology in real life, not just personality traits. It is about understanding how your energy actually moves.

If you want to go deeper than short interpretations, the HD Astro Membership teaches you how signs, houses, degrees, aspects, and the 64 Human Design Gates all work together inside your own chart. Instead of collecting scattered meanings, you learn how to read the full structure.

You can explore the HD Astro Membership here:
https://healthmanifested.com/hd-astro-course-options

This is where astrology becomes something you can understand, apply, and grow with over time.
